title: Identity and access guards
interface: current_user() -> dict | None from flask.session: {'email': lower-case str, 'is_admin': bool (email in current_app.config['ADMIN_EMAILS'])}. Decorators for view functions: login_required (anonymous -> redirect 302 to '/auth/login?next=<path>'), admin_required (anonymous -> 302 to login; logged in non-admin -> 403 JSON {'error': 'admin required'} when the request path starts with '/api/' else a 403 HTML/plain response), api_auth_required (accepts either Authorization: Bearer <key> with key in config['API_KEYS'] — sets flask.g.api_actor='api:<first 4 chars of key>' — or an admin session; missing/invalid key and no session -> 401 JSON {'error': 'unauthorized'}; a non-admin session -> 403 JSON {'error': 'admin required'}). actor() -> str: g.api_actor if set, else the session email, else 'anonymous'. All decorators use functools.wraps.
notes: No acceptance test of its own; exercised through tests/test_auth.py after the app exists.
